author_crosscheck.note: The author's private checks, not produced by likelihood.py: R 4.5.2 with MASS 7.3.65 (glm for the V-1 Poisson fit; glm.nb and fitdistr for Greenwood and Yule; glm.nb and glm for the V-1 likelihood ratio), and the powerlaw 2.0.0 Python package (Fit and distribution_compare with normalized_ratio=True on the regenerated sample). Your own run will not have this key. The lab's values here are read from this file, which rounds to six significant digits, so differences up to 4e-4 are rounding.
author_crosscheck.r_note: glm.nb's SE.theta is the observed information evaluated at the fitted means of its last inner iteration, so it differs from the lab's 0.186251 in the fifth digit; fitdistr's SEs agree to 1e-6.
